YOUR ASSIGNMENT
Maya Chen

Social media strategist. She builds campaigns for businesses that are ready to grow.

Maya has been approached by Gathered, a curated gift and lifestyle shop. Before she recommends a single campaign idea, she needs to understand whether the numbers support growth.

She is handing the keys to you. Run Gathered for three quarters. Make the purchasing decisions. Watch what happens to the statements. At the end, tell Maya what you found.
